snippet.title: Tradie Tapper // Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3713180/Tradie_Tapper/

Tap, hire, and rebirth your way to tradie stardom in this Aussie-made idle clicker. Build job sites, collect gear, unlock skill trees, and climb the monthly leaderboards. Whether you're laying bricks or chasing ranks, the grind never stops.

Developed by
Adventure Quest
